newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Scotts aims to manage food court chain.
newsitem.headline: Scotts aims to manage food court chain.

text.p: Retail and property group Scotts Holdings said on Monday it was looking to manage a chain of food courts in Asia.
"We are getting management contracts in the region to manage food courts," an official told the company's annual general meeting.
It had ceased its loss-making restaurant operations and would concentrate on getting fees for managing food courts in its food and beverage business, officials said.
Scotts runs the Picnic food court in Singapore and was looking to run a chain under the Picnic name regionally, they said.

On whether the company would run more food courts in Singapore after it sold its Lau Pa Sat Festival Market for S$8.0 million, an official said: "Lau Pa Sat is a commercial decision. We will go into any food court business in Singapore if there is any profit to be made."
